items.rationale: The case-study review (drafted Sunday evening at the library) went out Monday afternoon with six line edits on Lonestar and structural suggestions on Marlin, unblocking the design phase ahead. The review walkthrough with Maya and Renee is locked for Tuesday 2:30 p.m., with the comps landing Tuesday afternoon to stay on track for the May 21 ship target.

Avery's review of Aaron's data-security addendum is in her notes — send back the three tracked changes today (72-hour breach, clarified subprocessor scope, encryption-at-rest accepted) to keep the signature call on track for Friday, May 22.

Avery locked June 27–28 with Ethan on May 17 (proposed the dates, awaiting his response). The wedding-block decision now centers on two items: decide room class with Sam (likely a king) and confirm the Sentinel Hotel block reservation by July 15 deadline.

Marlene will email this afternoon asking for scope clarity on the Q2 financial section and cap-table waterfall scenario; Avery's standing position is to defer both until the term-sheet picture clarifies.

Tom Halpern's Monday-afternoon email flagged a SOC 2 system-description peer-review wording issue, slipping the final report from May 19 to Wednesday May 20 (24–36 hour slip). The slip overlaps Friday's hard-stop third-diligence deadline. Marlene's concurrent scope questions on the Q2 board pack (burn depth, KPI set, cap-table model) have been deferred to Monday May 25 to create breathing room and align with her May books close and June 1 prep timeline.

Josie announced Wren's TK class assignment — AM section, Ms. Devin Park and Mr. Cameron Liu, 18 in the cohort, with health forms due June 1. Kaiser rescheduled Wren's pediatrician appointment from Friday May 22 at 2:15 p.m. to Thursday May 28 at 3:30 p.m. due to provider CME conflict; Sam accepted the reschedule. Avery and Sam have not yet discussed whether to keep or cancel the rescheduled appointment given Wren's strep recovery trajectory.
